guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Regarding the Company’s outlook, Mr. Pruitt said, “Our results this year highlight the durability of our business. Despite significant energy headwinds, we are preserving our Adjusted EBITDA margin and expanding unit profitability in aggregates. We have taken proactive pricing and cost actions to mitigate the elevated energy inflation that has continued into the fourth quarter. Backed by our operational and commercial discipline, we expect to deliver approximately $2.4 billion in Adjusted EBITDA for the full year.

Mr. Pruitt continued, “As we look to 2027, our execution and ongoing portfolio expansion set the stage for another year of earnings growth. We anticipate a continuation of the current demand environment next year and expect to continue expanding aggregates cash gross profit per ton with mid- to high- single digit pricing gains through execution of the Vulcan Way of Selling and cost benefits from the Vulcan Way of Operating.

“We have the right aggregates-led strategy and the operational rigor to navigate dynamic market conditions. By maintaining disciplined capital deployment, integrating high-quality assets into our network, and executing on the fundamentals we control, we will continue to generate strong cash flow and compound superior value for our shareholders.”
